text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I know how much effort <chrname> has put in up to 
this day. I know her sweat. I know the 
pain she endured.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even so—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Even after going this far, is the world 
still so out of reach...?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: —...Even after doing all this, still...

text_block_list.name: Japanese Fan
text_block_list.text:
...And here I thought I'd finally win this 
year.

text_block_list.name: Japanese Fan
text_block_list.text:
"You did great too, <chrname>. This year's lineup 
was really stacked."

text_block_list.name: Japanese Fan
text_block_list.text:
Venus Park and all the others were just 
too strong. ...Everyone says we did really 
well considering.

text_block_list.name: Japanese Fan
text_block_list.text: This was simply my limit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —<chrname>'s challenge has come to an end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I close my eyes and reflect on today's 
events. Collapsing onto the bed, resting 
my head against the pillow—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Opening the door, I stepped out of the 
room. I had nowhere in particular in mind 
to go.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Click...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Who invited whom first at that moment? 
Before we knew it, the two of us were 
walking out of the hotel.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We walked along the Seine, passing through 
the lights of the city. And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*tap, tap, tap—*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> was running on the outdoor racecourse she 
had grown so thoroughly familiar with.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*tap, tap, tap—*) (*tap, tap, tap—*)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hmph...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether the heat wavering here right now 
is frustration or jealousy, I cannot tell 
its true nature.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, only the sound of heavy breathing 
echoed throughout the room.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In complete silence, everyone kicked up 
the turf.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"None of the girls who set their sights on 
the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe have given 
up on winning. ...There's no way they ever 
would."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Because the challenge is still ongoing.
